days.title: Delhi – Jaipur (By Surface – 260kms & 06hrs)
days.desc: After Buffet breakfast at Hotel, Half day City tour of Delhi visiting India Gate, President house, Government building from outside. Also visit to Agrasen ki Baoli-Delhi & move for lunch at local restaurant.

days.title: Jaipur City Tour
days.desc: Enjoy morning yoga session at the hotel. Post breakfast proceed for full day city tour visit Amber Fort [Uphill by Elephant/Downhill by Jeep] En-route photo stop at Hawa Mahal. Return back to hotel for lunch, photo stop at Jal Mahal.

days.title: Jaipur – Ranthambore (By Surface – 260kms & 06hrs)
days.desc: Post breakfast check-out from the hotel and proceed to Ranthambore. Upon arrival Later check – in at Hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Ranthambore
days.desc: Early morning enjoy Game Drive in Ranthambore National Park Shared basis on Open  Canter. Return to Hotel for Buffet breakfast.

days.title: Ranthambore- Abhaneri- Fatehpur Sikri-Agra (By Surface 295 Kms/ 5.5 hrs drive)
days.desc: After buffet breakfast at hotel, checkout from hotel. Start your drive to Agra Enroute visit Abhaneri and visit stepwell and Fatehpur Sikri sightseeing. Lunch in local restaurant in Fatehpur sikri. Continue your drive to Agra.

days.title: Agra – Delhi (By Surface – 210kms & 5hrs)

tour7.title: Honeymoon Trip in Kerala
tour7.route: Cochin to  Munnar – Periyar to  Alleppey  to  Mararikulam  to  Kovalam  to  Trivandrum
tour7.destinations: Cochin,  Munnar – Periyar,  Alleppey ,  Mararikulam ,  Kovalam ,  Trivandrum

days.title: Arrive at Cochin
days.desc: Arrive at Cochin International Airport. Following customs, immigration formalities and baggage collection, our representative will meet you as you exit the arrival terminal building after which you would be transferred to your hotel.

days.title: Cochin
days.desc: Morning enjoy half day sightseeing tour of Cochin. The tour allows you to explore the charming fort Cochin, visit Jewish Synagogue, Dutch Palace, Jew Town, and St Francis church. Fort Kochi is a small village located near the larger city of Kochi.

days.title: Cochin to Munnar (125 / 04 Hrs )
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Munnar Munnar is a haven of peace and harmony. This incredibly beautiful hill town is positioned at a height of 6000ft in the Idukki district.

days.title: Munnar
days.desc: Morning visit Eravikulam National Park. The park is an ideal place for seeing the biodiversity of high elevation shola-grassland ecosystem. Visitors are taken to Rajamalai in forest department vehicles and given an opportunity to see all this.

days.title: Munnar to Periyar (100 Kms / 03 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Periyar , The Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary is situated on the banks of the Periyar Lake - an artificial lake, at Thekkady.

days.title: Periyar
days.desc: Morning visit to Periyar National Park Tourists come to the National Park to view the Indian elephants in the act of ablution and playfulness by the Periyar lake.

days.title: Periyar to Alleppey (127 Kms / 05 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface leave for Alleppey Later embark houseboat followed by lunch at house boat. These houseboats or Kettuvallams as they are traditionally called were at one time the mode of transportation for man and goods.

days.title: Alleppey – Mararikulam (20 Kms /45 Min)
days.desc: Morning disembark houseboat and enjoy a walk around the village - “Alleppey on Foot”.

days.title: Mararikulam
days.desc: Learn from our master Yoga teacher giving you expert guidance, this ancient science of wellness acquires a new dimension. One of the best things about yoga is that almost anyone can do it regardless of age.

days.title: Mararikulam to Kovalam (178 Km/04 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning by surface drive to Kovalam , Arrive at Kovalam and transfer to the hotel. Kovalam is an internationally renowned beach with three adjacent crescent beaches. It has been a favourite haunt of tourists, especially Europeans, since the 1930s.

days.title: Kovalam
days.desc: Early morning you may experience yoga session on the beach. Kovalam is also a getaway destination for those in search of an Ayurvedic haven away from the cacophony of city life. The experience is personal and unique.

days.title: Kovalam – Day excursion of Padmanabhapuram Palace and Kanyakumari
days.desc: In the morning proceed for the day excursion to Padmanabhapuram Palace and Kanyakumari (184 Km both ways). Padmanabhapuram Palace, regarded as Asia's largest wooden palace located at Thiruvananthapuram in Kerala.

days.title: Kovalam to Trivandrum and Departure
days.desc: Morning after breakfast, transfer to Trivandrum Airport and connect to onward flight journey.

days.desc: Upon arrival at Delhi airport, meet assist and transfer to hotel India’s capital and a major gateway to the country, contemporary Delhi is a bustling metropolis, which successfully combines in its folds - the ancient with the modern.

days.title: Delhi / Srinagar (By Flight)
days.desc: Early breakfast at hotel Have breakfast at the hotel and depart for the airport, take a flight to Srinagar (flying about 1 hr 30 minutes) On arrival in Srinagar, You will be greeted & start drive to Srinagar for 35 minutes.

days.title: Srinagar – Pahalgam - Srinagar
days.desc: After breakfast, Checkout from Houseboat. Drive to Pahalgam for Same day excursion. Pahalgam is a hill station in the north Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir.

days.title: Srinagar – Gulmarg – Srinagar
days.desc: After breakfast full day excursion of Gulmarg - the most beautiful summer resort in the valley. Gulmarg is the crowning glory of Jammu & Kashmir and is located 2,650 meters above sea level. Known as the “Meadow of Flowers”, it boasts of the worlds.

days.title: Srinagar – Delhi(Flight)  - Agra ( Surface 200 kms/ 4 hrs approx..)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel. Early in the morning enjoy the beauty of Dal Lake that God has graced this city with which is often compared to Venice.

days.title: Agra/Jaipur by Surface (Approx 255 Kms / 4.5 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel. Morning Half day sightseeing of Taj Mahal & Agra Fort. Visiting Taj Mahal“The embodiment of all things pure”, said Rudyard Kipling on Taj Mahal’s beauty and that is no wordplay as the Taj is undoubtedly a pure epitome of beauty.

days.title: Jaipur/Delhi by Surface (Approx 260 Kms / 5 Hrs)
days.desc: After early Breakfast. Proceed for sightseeing tour of City Palace & Amer fort – (Jeep ride) City Palace complex was conceived and built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, the founder of Jaipur.

tour9.title: Rajasthan Forts and Palaces Tour
tour9.route: Delhi  to  Mandawa  to  Bikaner  to  Jaisalmer  to  Jodhpur – Ranakpur  to  Udaipur  to  Pushkar  to  Jaipur – Fatehpur Sikri  to  Agra – Delhi
tour9.destinations: Delhi ,  Mandawa ,  Bikaner ,  Jaisalmer ,  Jodhpur – Ranakpur ,  Udaipur ,  Pushkar ,  Jaipur – Fatehpur Sikri ,  Agra – Delhi
images: images/india_tours/Rajasthan Forts and Palaces Tour/Taj Mahal.jpg

days.title: Arrive Delhi by Flight
days.desc: Arrive at Delhi’s Airport. Welcome to India! and transferred to hotel for check in. Delhi, India’s capital territory, is a massive metropolitan area in the country’s north.

days.title: Delhi- Mandawa (257 Kms. /06 Hrs. drive)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Mandawa, on arrival at Mandawa, Check in to Hotel. Visit the Mandawa Fort - Mandawa Fort is an important heritage site of Shekhawati.

days.title: Mandawa-Bikaner (190 Kms. /04 Hrs. drive)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Bikaner, Visit the Junagarh Fort (1571-1611 AD) constructed of red sandstone and marble with kiosks and balconies embellishing the structure at intervals. On arrival at Bikaner, Check in to hotel. Overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Bikaner - Jaisalmer (Approx. 330 Kms / 06 Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, drive through the desert and proceed for Jaisalmer. Very often one can see along the road to Jaisalmer some of the antelopes of this region. Blackbuck and fast running Chinkara are the most common among them.

days.title: Jaisalmer
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Sightseeing in Jaisalmer. There will have a walk through the old city and visit the carved havellis, fort, Jain temple and Gadisar Lake. In the afternoon will drive around 40 km.

days.title: Jaisalmer- Osian- Jodhpur (Approx. 280 Kms / 05 Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, drive to Jodhpur via Osian. Osian is a great center of Hindu and Jain religions. The oldest Temple here was constructed in 1178 AD. In Jodhpur you will visit the Mehrangarh Fort (majestic fort).

days.title: Jodhpur- Ranakpur- Udaipur (250 Kms. /5 ½ Hrs.)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Drive to Udaipur, en-route visit Ranakpur Jain Temple, This 15th-century temple, dedicated to Lord Rishabdeva, is renowned for its intricate marble carvings and stunning architecture.

days.title: Udaipur
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, Sightseeing of Udaipur, Visit the City Palace, a sprawling complex of palaces built over 400 years. Explore the palace’s various courtyards, rooms, and museums, including the Crystal Gallery and the Peacock Courtyard.

days.title: Udaipur-Pushkar (Approx. 280 Kms / 06 Hrs.)
days.desc: This morning, have breakfast and then leave for Pushkar to enjoy the last set of attractions during your tour of Rajasthan. On reaching Pushkar, check in at the hotel and freshen up. After that, your guide will take you sightseeing around the place.

days.title: Pushkar-Jaipur (Approx. 141 Kms / 02 Hrs. 30 Min)
days.desc: Leave for Jaipur in the morning, after breakfast. You then check in to your hotel room and spend the rest of the day at your own leisure. Later, in the evening/night, you come back to the room and stay overnight.

days.title: Jaipur
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then proceed for sightseeing visiting Amer Fort - 11 Kms from Jaipur is Amber, the ancient capital of Jaipur state construction of the Fort Palace was constructed in 1652 by Raja Mansingh and it was later extended & completed by...

days.title: Jaipur-Abhneri-Fatehpursikri-Agra (Approx. 240 Kms / 5 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then drive to Agra, En-route visit Abhaneri and Fatehpur Sikri- 37 Km, The deserted city of sandstone built by the Emperor.

days.title: Agra-Delhi(Approx. 240 Kms / 4 Hrs)
days.desc: Breakfast at hotel, then drive to Delhi.

days.title: Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast and energize yourself for a day full of excitement and fun. Then, enjoy your day with a sightseeing tour around this beautiful city. Start your tour with a visit to Laxmi Narayan Temple, which is well-known as the Birla Mandir.

days.title: Leave Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast proceed to Delhi airport to board flight for onward destination. *****Tour Ends******

tour10.route: Chennai to Pondicherry to Tanjore to Trichy to Madurai to Periyar to Cochin to Allepy to Kovalam to Trivendrum
tour10.destinations: Chennai, Pondicherry, Tanjore, Trichy, Madurai, Periyar, Cochin, Allepy, Kovalam, Trivendrum

days.title: Arrival in Chennai
days.desc: You will get a warm welcome by our airport representative / Guide on your arrival at Airport; He will be assisting you for the transfer to the hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.

days.title: Chennai
days.desc: Chennai, the capital city, popularly regarded as the ‘Gateway to the South represents a culture that is distinctly different from that of northern India. After breakfast visit, Fort St.

days.title: Chennai-Pondicherry(approx 161 kms / 03 Hrs)
days.desc: Morning drive to Pondicherry enroute visiting The  city  of  Mahabalipuram, famous for the seven pagodas. Here  on the  seashore  is an interesting group of ancient rock temples which  are the  examples of  Dravidian style of Architecture.

days.title: Pondicherry-Thanjore (approx 200 kms / 04 hrs)
days.desc: Morning after breakfast visit Pondicherry city, the capital of French India before independence,  Pondicherry  traces its  origin  to  Saint  Agasthya, the revered sage of the south and excavations near-by reveal that a Roman settlement existed here...

days.title: Thanjore-Trichy
days.desc: After breakfast half day visit to Trichy (approx 50 kms / 30 minutes one way). The  Rock-Fort  is   the landmark of Trichy. A climb of 434 steps leads to the ancient   temple of Ganapati on top and a further climb to a Shiva temple.

days.title: Trichy-Madurai (approx 182 kms / 05 hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast at the hotel drive to Madurai, on arrival check in the hotel. Afternoon visit the famous Meenakshi Temple dedicated to the  consort of   Lord Shiva  with  its towering gopurams (rising high above the  surrounding country  side).

days.title: Madurai-Periyar (approx 170 kms / 04 hrs)
days.desc: Morning drive to Periyar. The earliest sanctuary to be set up in 1934, it extends to 777  square kms & forms part of the high mountain ranges, the Western Ghats. Wild life  can  be  seen while cruising on Periyar Lake in  a  motor  boat.

days.title: Periyar-Cochin (approx 160 kms / 04 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Cochin, on arrival check in the hotel, Overnight in the hotel

days.title: Cochin
days.desc: Morning after breakfast city tour of the Cochin ity. Cochin is the natural harbour created by the famed underwater Malabar mud-banks whose quality ensures that the rougher the seas are outside the calmer the waters are within the Harbour.

days.title: Cochin-Alleppey (approx 60 kms / 01 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Alleppey and board the houseboatd. The coastal town of Alleppey on the Arabian Sea is the Venice of the East, for the numerous canals that meander through the town Overnight stay in the hotel

days.title: Alleppey-Kovalam(approx 160 kms / 3.5 Hrs)
days.desc: After breakfast de-board the houseboat at Thottapally and drive to Kovalam, on arrival check in the hotel, rest of the day is free Overnight stay in the hotel.

days.title: Kovalam
days.desc: After breakfast full day excursion to Kanya kumari enroute visiting Padmanabhapuram Palace, on arrival at Kanyakumari visit the Vivekananda Rock, the national monument dedicated to Swami Vivekananda.

days.d: Day at leisure. Overnight stay in the hotel

days.title: Kovalam-Trivandrum airport Drop.
days.desc: After breakfast transfer to Trivandrum Airport to board the flight for onward destination

tour12.destinations: Delhi – Srinagar – Pahalgam – Kargil – Leh –– Nubra – Nubra Valley,  Pangong Lake – Leh ,  Delhi
images: images/india_tours/Srinagar with Leh Ladakh Tour/images nu.jpg

days.title: Delhi - Srinagar
days.desc: On arrival at the Srinagar Airport, you will be welcomed by our representative who will assist and escort you to your waiting vehicle. From the airport it is a 35 minutes’ drive through the heart of New Srinagar city.

days.title: Srinagar - Pahalgalm – Srinagar (60 Km / 2 Hrs)
days.desc: After Breakfast drive to Pahalgam and full day excursion to Pahalgam 2440 Mtrs (vale of Kashmir) on the way visit Saffron fields,  Avantipur ruins and Anantnag sulpher spring. Pahalgam is the most famous place for Indian Film Industry.

days.title: Srinagar – Kargil (204 Kms)
days.desc: After breakfast drive directly to Kargil & drive through Sonamarg. Situated at an altitude of 9000 Ft. Sonamarg – 84 Kms is also called as “The meadow of gold” has, as its backdrop, snowy mountains against a cerulean sky.

days.title: Kargil - Leh  (Approx. 234 Km)
days.desc: After breakfast proceed for Leh. Enroute pass the confluence of Indus – Zanskar Rivers and the effects of Magnetic Hill (Defiance of the law of gravity).

days.title: Leh
days.desc: After breakfast full day visit to Samker Gompa & Leh Bazaar, Leh Monastry, Shanti Stupa and Leh Palace. Tson-Kha-Pa. The Sankar Gompa shares a distance of 2-3 km from the main town of Leh.

days.title: Leh – Nubra Valley
days.desc: This morning drive to Nubra valley. On arrival check in camp. In Afternoon visit the popular Samasthanling Monastery at Sumoor followed by dinner and overnight camp.

days.title: Nubra Valley
days.desc: Nubra Valley is a wonderful place. Nubra Valley has extremely cold tempertatures during the winter, but the scenario all around is so mesmerizing that it has become a favorite tourist spot in Jammu and Kashmir.

days.title: Nubra Valley – Pangong Lake
days.desc: After early Breakfast drive to Pangong Lake. On arrival check in to the camp.

days.title: Pangong Lake - Leh
days.desc: After breakfast drive to Leh. On arrival, check in hotel in afternoon. Take rest than evening is at leisure. Overnight stay at hotel in Leh.

days.title: Leh – Delhi By Flight
days.desc: After breakfast drop at Leh airport for onward journey.

days.title: - Leave Delhi
days.desc: After breakfast transferred to the international airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your wonderful journey through India
